newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best affirms seven Aetna HMO ratings.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best affirms seven Aetna HMO ratings.

text.p: U.S. insurance rating agency A.M. Best Co said on Monday it reaffirmed its ratings on seven Aetna U.S. Healthcare health maintenance organization operating entities.
U.S. Healthcare of Pennsylvania Inc, U.S. Healthcare of New York and Health Maintenance Organization of N.J. Inc were affirmed as "A+" or superior, the agency said.

U.S. Healthcare Inc entities in Delaware, Connecticut and Massachusetts were affirmed with "A" or excellent ratings, it said. U.S. Healthcare of Georgia Inc was affirmed with an "A-" or excellent rating.
A.M. Best said it also affirmed the "A" or excellent rating of Aetna Life Insurance Co and the "A+" or superior rating of Aetna Life Insurance and Annuity Co.

The ratings reflected the operating entities' strong earnings and operating positions in the greater New York City and Philadelphia metropolitan areas and New Jersey and Aetna U.S. Healthcare's strong national brand name, medical quality and financial backing, the agency said.
